categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies output structure for getrawtransaction, getblock, and REST block endpoints.
categories.rationale: This addresses a documented feature request (#27391) by decoding redeem and witness scripts directly in RPC outputs so callers do not have to manually parse witness stacks and invoke separate decoding calls. While it removes an inconvenient workaround for downstream tooling inspecting transactions, the missing fields do not block core functionality, making the addition worthwhile but deferrable.
